title: Differential gene expression in proximal tubule epithelial cells in acute kidney injury (KPMP 2021)
bodyHtml:
The plot and table below show differential expression of the listed genes in kidney proximal tubule epithelial cells from individuals with or without acute kidney injury. Cells were in the adaptive, maladaptive, or repairing cell states, retaining differentiation markers of reference states, albeit at lower levels, but also showing expression of known injury associated genes, mesenchymal markers or factors promoting inflammation or fibrosis.

The results were downloaded from the Kidney Precision Medicine Project (KPMP):

Rationale and design of the Kidney Precision Medicine Project.
de Boer IH et al.
Kidney Int. 2021 Mar;99(3):498-510. doi: 10.1016/j.kint.2020.08.039.
PMID: 33637194

View results from this study in the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
